name: InFoBench
description: InFoBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' instruction-following ability by decomposing complex instructions into simpler criteria. It contains 500 diverse instructions and 2,250 decomposed questions across multiple constraint categories, enabling detailed analysis of LLM compliance with task requirements.
reputation: A recent instruction-following benchmark that has been used in LLM evaluation papers, but it is not yet as widely standardized as major leaderboards.
notes: Introduces a new metric DRFR for instruction-following evaluation; compares annotation sources including GPT-4.
